source_config.labels_source: Sorted unique stripped glosses from official training CSV, as upstream Dataset does.
source_config.preprocessing: Unmodified upstream video loader, pad and CenterCrop; retains OpenCV BGR order despite RGB name.
source_config.temporal_readout: Linear interpolation to 64 frame logits, then temporal maximum, as official testing code.

protocol.channel_order: OpenCV BGR, matching upstream despite RGB loader name
protocol.padding: Unmodified random first/last append padding; numpy seed 0 and fixed input order, workers=0.
protocol.reproduction_limit: Official script shuffles data with workers=2; order-dependent endpoint padding can differ. This is not a full-test reproduction of the paper.

5.interpretation: Output logits restricted and renormalized to the same pilot labels; original 2731-output weights/head unchanged, no training.

15.interpretation: Output logits restricted and renormalized to the same pilot labels; original 2731-output weights/head unchanged, no training.
